headline: Cuba Restructures Government to 20 Ministries
summary: Cuba's Law 186 sets the government structure at 20 ministries plus the central bank, taking effect on November 9.
why: Government administrative reforms alter bureaucratic oversight and state-directed economic planning in Cuba.
